Water damage is one of those problems where a single sensor can save you a fortune in repairs, whether it's flooring or cabinetry. Leak sensors have long been one of the best-value purchases in the smart home category, and Shelly's latest Flood S Gen4 makes getting started easier than ever. Priced under $30, it's Matter-certified and works with Apple Home straight out of the box.

HomeKit Weekly is a series focused on smart home accessories, automation tips and tricks, and everything related to Apple's smart home framework.

Larger Sensing Area

Most leak sensors on the market use small metal probes on the bottom, meaning water has to pool in exactly the right spot to trigger an alarm. Shelly's new sensor takes a completely different approach, with three large stainless steel sensing plates on the underside. The greater contact area means it can detect water faster and in more locations — exactly what you want when placing a sensor under a water heater or washing machine.

These plates are sensitive enough to detect cleaning water or low-conductivity water, such as condensate from an air conditioner. These kinds of leaks are typically harder to spot. The Flood S Gen4 is also slim enough to slide under appliances, behind toilets, and beneath sinks — all the places you're most likely to want one of these devices.

Matter / Apple Home Support

The Flood S Gen4 is Matter-certified and supports both Wi-Fi and Zigbee, so it works with Apple Home, Google Home, Amazon Alexa, SmartThings, and Home Assistant. Once added to Apple Home, the automation possibilities multiply significantly:

  • Cut power to a washing machine or dishwasher the moment water is detected (if plugged into a smart outlet)
  • Trigger every smart bulb in the house
  • Simply receive a leak alert on your iPhone (especially handy if you're out)

Modes, Alerts, and Battery Life

In addition to phone notifications, there's a built-in local alarm so that even if your phone is in another room, people at home will be alerted. Shelly offers two operating modes (flood detection and rainwater detection) and three alarm settings (intense, normal, and economy), letting you balance leak detection speed against battery life. Using the included CR123A battery, it can last up to two years.

Wrap-Up

Priced under $30, this is the kind of accessory where you'll happily pick up three or four for your home. Place one in front of the water heater, in front of the dishwasher, under the washing machine, and beneath the kitchen sink. Matter / Apple Home support means you can receive notifications via the Home app and build Apple Home automations around it. There's a lot to like here, and I can't find a single downside. Trust me, a water sensor is the smartest investment you'll make for your smart home.

You can purchase the Shelly Flood S Gen4 directly from Amazon or the Shelly website.
